query: WITH entities AS ((SELECT created_at, id FROM tasks WHERE (NOT $1 OR workspace_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM $2) AND COALESCE(status = $3, $3 IS NULL) AND ((created_at, id) < ($6, $5)) AND ($5 IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT $4) UNION ALL (SELECT created_at, id FROM tasks WHERE (NOT $1 OR workspace_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM $2) AND COALESCE(status = $3, $3 IS NULL) AND ($5 IS NULL) ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT $4) ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT $4) SELECT i.id AS "entity_id!: Repo__Id", e.sequence, e.event, CASE WHEN $7 THEN e.context ELSE NULL::jsonb END as "context: es_entity::ContextData", e.recorded_at, NULL::jsonb as "forgettable_payload?" FROM entities i JOIN task_events e ON i.id = e.id ORDER BY i.created_at desc, i.id desc, i.id, e.sequence
